authorReviewNote: Obstacle courses defining Fall Guys, unlike flight/war/diving campaigns. Actual official homepage title explicitly battle-royale obstacle-course game. Broad main challenge description, not all rounds identical.

Replaced uncorroborated jelly-bean-sweets comparison. Actual official homepage explicitly Fall Guys Creative course construction. Other real activities are distinct game types. Does not imply all players must build or only developer can publish.

Regular wool bed sleeps and sets respawn in Overworld; chest/table/cauldron do not. Minecraft official respawning guide explicitly changing spawn with bed, original beginner guide sleep. Explicit regular wool bed avoids new straw-bed exception, Overworld avoids explosive Nether/End.

Publisher actual description explicitly pranks/stealing hats/possessions. Other options games involving vehicle racing, building settlements and raising farm animals, not goose mischief. No implied violence or country claim.

Publisher calls slapstick-stealth-sandbox. Stealth and mischief fits puzzles; racing, military flight and card collecting wrong core styles. Does not assert every encounter requires stealth or game only has one genre.
Publisher explicitly two horrible geese and two-player cooperative update. Three/four/six not supported normal local co-op count. Scoped local coop, not unsupported global player statistics.
